name: BLE-04 修改编排 → 推送 → arrangementVersion 递增

setup.code: if (!globalThis.__bleMock) throw new Error('ble-mock 未注入'); return globalThis.__bleMock.getState();

steps.code: const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; const d = p.data.devices[0]; if (!d) throw new Error('设备列表为空：扫描未发现 ML-8DCC'); return p.onTapDevice({ currentTarget: { dataset: { deviceId: d.deviceId, name: d.name } } });
const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; return { route: p.route, deviceId: p.data.deviceId, connected: !!p.data.connected, error: p.data.error || '' };

const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; const t = await p.requestToken(); if (!t.granted) throw new Error('令牌获取失败: ' + (t.reason || 'unknown')); const st = globalThis.__bleMock.getState(); const hex = st.lastStatusHex || ''; const b = hex.match(/../g) ? hex.match(/../g).map((x) => parseInt(x, 16)) : []; const base = b.length >= 3 ? ((b[1] | (b[2] << 8)) & 0xffff) : 0; const arr = p.store.loadOrCreate(p._deviceName); arr.pins[0].length = 10; arr.pins[0].name = 'E2E'; arr.pins[0].groups = [{ ranges: [{ start: 0, end: 10, reverse: false }], stages: [{ durationMs: 1000, fadeInMs: 0, layers: [{ role: 0, effectId: 0, params: [255, 0, 0] }] }] }]; arr.version = (base + 1) & 0xffff; p.store.save(p._deviceName, arr); await p.pushArrangementAction(); return { base, version: arr.version, transferMessage: p.data.transferMessage || '', statusVersion: p._lastStatusFrame ? p._lastStatusFrame.arrangementVersion : null };
